name: RightSignature
agentUseSummary: Connect one RightSignature user through Relay-owned authorization-code OAuth with exactly the read scope. Relay exposes two fixed privacy-redacted document lifecycle reads and blocks filenames, PDFs, signed files, certificates, participants, form fields, signing, templates, sends, writes, broader authority, raw access, pagination, polling, retries, and exports.

capabilities.label: List documents
capabilities.description: Read a bounded first page of privacy-redacted document lifecycle metadata.

capabilities.label: Inspect document metadata
capabilities.description: Read privacy-redacted lifecycle metadata for one explicit document.

allowed.label: List documents
allowed.description: List up to 25 first-page document lifecycle summaries for one explicit state.

allowed.label: Inspect a document
allowed.description: Inspect lifecycle metadata for one explicit document UUID.

blocked.label: Access private document content
blocked.description: Filenames, PDFs, original or signed files, certificates, thumbnails, participants, signers, shared users, messages, fields, tags, identity data, and URLs are blocked.

blocked.label: Mutate or send documents
blocked.description: Preparing, uploading, sending, embedding, sharing, signing, reminding, voiding, updating, deleting, and administering are blocked.

blocked.label: Use broader authority
blocked.description: The write scope, private API tokens, templates, sending requests, signer operations, users, callbacks, and webhooks are blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw or bulk APIs
blocked.description: Raw paths, search, template filters, arbitrary queries, pagination, polling, automatic retries, batch access, and exports are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Read-only document lifecycle
approvalProfiles.description: Two fixed privacy-redacted document metadata reads run automatically with exactly RightSignature's read scope.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Exact read scope, fixed paths, strict projection, result cap, and read-only boundary remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway brokers exact-read OAuth and mounts two fixed privacy-redacted document lifecycle reads.
Railway brokers exact-read OAuth and mounts two fixed privacy-redacted document lifecycle reads.

providerSetup.blocker: RightSignature API access requires ShareFile Premium or Industry Advantage, or an API specialist trial, plus an approved API key and Relay-owned client credentials. No provider-console, API-key request, credential, consent, Railway, or live acceptance work is authorized in this worker task.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized owner obtains an approved RightSignature API key, registers the exact Railway callback with only read scope, stores the client ID/secret through Railway's secret process, deploys separately, and runs live connect, list/get redaction, refresh, revoke/disconnect, and post-disconnect denial acceptance.

evidence.supports: RightSignature documents third-party authorization-code OAuth, two-hour access tokens, refresh tokens, and approved API credentials.
RightSignature documents GET /oauth/authorize and the exact read, write, or read write scope choices; Relay requests only read.
RightSignature documents token exchange, refresh, Bearer authentication, and POST /oauth/revoke with client authentication.
RightSignature documents GET /public/v2/documents with state/per_page/page and GET /public/v2/documents/{id}.
RightSignature documents the paid-plan/API-specialist and approved API-key prerequisites.
